subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should maintainers proceed from the source-level same-batch cron proof and repair the open incremental-persistence PR, or require a live reproduction of the reporter's exact single-cron setup before landing?
rationale: The issue has concrete latest-release symptoms and a clear current-main source path, but the exact one-job report is not live-proven and two overlapping PRs have different proof and merge-readiness states.

options.title: Repair and review PR 100597
options.body: Use the active closing PR as the canonical fix path, require its review findings and real behavior proof to be addressed, then close this issue by merge.

options.title: Adapt PR 81572 instead
options.body: Reuse the older PR's live proof and implementation direction, but rebase it through current cron finalization safeguards before considering merge.

options.title: Require exact live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue and both PRs paused until a live packaged run reproduces the reporter's single-cron `running_at_ms` failure.

recommendation.title: Repair and review PR 100597
recommendation.body: Use the active closing PR as the canonical fix path, require its review findings and real behavior proof to be addressed, then close this issue by merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their broad cron scheduler reliability work makes them the strongest routing candidate for deciding the scheduler-state proof threshold.
